en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing an urban street scene with a tramcar in the foreground, numbered 5, running along a wide avenue lined with multi‑storey neoclassical and eclectic buildings. A domed building appears in the mid‑distance on the left, and a large ornate facade on the right edge. At the top in red French text it reads "Souvenir de Salonique (Grèce)". The overall design and wear suggest an early 20th‑century postcard from a European city.
